Context: Not eligible:-

- (4) An employee is not eligible for the award for passing Hindi Typewriting / Stenography examination, if (a) he had a speed of 25 w.p.m. in Hindi Typewriting/BO w.p.m. in Hindi Stenography before joining Government service, or (b) he received training and passed a test in Hindi . Typewriting/Hindi Stenography from a recognized institution, and (c) training in Hindi Typewriting/Stenography is not obligatory.
